reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: Zr is a known grain refiner and precipitate former in Al-containing alloys, and the proposed mechanisms (precipitate strengthening, grain boundary pinning, and chemical stabilization) are well-established for improving strength, creep, and corrosion resistance.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, but the falsification criterion (requiring >10-15% simultaneous improvement in all three properties) is overly strict; a lack of improvement in any single property would already falsify the core claim of a combined benefit.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is directly relevant and useful for the aerospace fastener application, proposing a specific, actionable alloying intervention with a clear comparative baseline and a well-defined testing protocol.
